body.statement: For a fixed deterministic choice rule, sIDP first decomposes every requested observed region only into proper region children.  At a terminal region \(R\), its fixing routine has a current set \(T_0\supseteq R\) and every successful iteration removes a nonempty bucket from \(T_0\).  Consequently every graph-only recursive or fixing subproblem is determined by either a region \(R\subseteq V\) or a pair \(R\subseteq T_0\subseteq V\).
